The '''2023–24 Bradley Braves men's basketball team''' represented [[Bradley University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Braves, led by ninth-year head coach [[Brian Wardle (basketball)|Brian Wardle]], played their home games at [[Carver Arena]] in [[Peoria, Illinois]] as members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]] (MVC). They finished the season 23–12, 13–7 in MVC play, to finish in third place. They defeated [[2023–24 UIC Flames men's basketball team|UIC]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2024 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kotcher |first=Luke |date=2024-03-08 |title=Game Recap: Bradley vs UIC |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2024/3/9/mens-basketball-game-recap-bradley-vs-uic.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2023–24 Drake Bulldogs men's basketball team|Drake]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kotcher |first=Luke |date=2024-03-09 |title=Game Recap: Bradley vs Drake |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2024/3/9/mens-basketball-game-recap-bradley-vs-drake.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> The Braves received a bid to the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as a No. 3 seed. They defeated [[2023–24 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola Chicago]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kotcher |first=Luke |date=2024-03-20 |title=Game Recap: Bradley vs Loyola |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2024/3/20/mens-basketball-game-recap-bradley-vs-loyola.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2023–24 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] in the second round.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kotcher |first=Luke |date=2024-03-23 |title=Game Recap: Bradley vs Cincinnati |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2024/3/24/mens-basketball-game-recap-bradley-vs-cincinnati.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2022–23 Bradley Braves men's basketball team|Braves]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 25–10, 16–4 in [[2022–23 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|MVC play]], to win the regular-season championship for the first time since [[1995–96 Bradley Braves men's basketball team|1996]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bradley wins MVC Regular Season Title for first time since 1996, defeating Drake 73-61 |url=https://www.25newsnow.com/2023/02/27/bradley-wins-mvc-regular-season-title-first-time-since-1996-defeating-drake-73-61/ |access-date=November 10, 2023 |website=25newsnow.com|date=27 February 2023 }}</ref> They defeated [[2022–23 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team|Northern Iowa]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Roskens |first=Cody |date=2023-03-03 |title=Game Preview: Bradley vs Indiana State |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2023/3/3/mens-basketball-game-preview-bradley-vs-indiana-state.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> and [[2022–23 Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball team|Indiana State]] in the [[2023 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kunstmann |first=Codie |date=2023-03-04 |title=Indiana State’s Arch Madness run ends in gut-wrenching fashion against top-seeded Bradley in tournament semifinals |url=https://gosycamores.com/news/2023/3/4/basketball-indiana-states-arch-madness-run-ends-in-gut-wrenching-fashion-against-top-seeded-bradley-in-tournament-semifinals.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Indiana State University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2022–23 Drake Bulldogs men's basketball team|Drake]] in the championship game.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Roskens |first=Cody |date=2023-03-05 |title=Arch Madness Recap |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2023/3/5/mens-basketball-arch-madness-recap.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref> As a regular-season champion who did not win their conference tournament, the Braves received an automatic bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jacques |first=Mike "Jocko" |date=2023-03-12 |title=Badgers men's basketball makes NIT after not being selected to NCAA Tournament |url=https://www.nbc15.com/2023/03/12/out-badgers-mens-basketball-not-selected-ncaa-tournament/ |access-date=November 10, 2023 |website=nbc15.com |language=en}}</ref> There, they lost to [[2022–23 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]] in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Roskens |first=Cody |date=2023-03-14 |title=Bradley's Historic Season Comes to a Close |url=https://bradleybraves.com/news/2023/3/15/mens-basketball-bradleys-historic-season-comes-to-a-close.aspx |access-date=2025-04-05 |website=Bradley University Athletics |language=en}}</ref>
